Title: Planer Serwisu - unconfirmed parts icon: display logic
Preconditions:
User is logged in
Calendar page (BOK or Warsztat) is loaded
Repair exists with field 'Części' = Wymagane
Parts confirmation has NOT been performed (no entry in SpRepair.SpRepairPartsConfirmation)

Step: Go to calendar view (BOK or Warsztat) with the task assigned to the repair.
Expected result: Calendar page is displayed with the task visible.

Step: Verify if 'Części niepotwierdzone' icon (box-open) is displayed on the task.
Expected result: Icon is displayed on the task.

Step: Hover over the icon to verify the tooltip/label.
End of test.
